Name: AhCuteArt's Extra Portraits and Assets
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Hi everyone! There were a few mod projects that I wanted to share with you all, but I didn't want to create a single mod page for each one. This mod is going to be a dumping ground for my custom projects, dropped works, and other miscellaneous things.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][u]Main File[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]MY CUSTOM FARMER PORTRAIT- Seasonal and Expressive Reactions - Simple[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]After popular demand, I decided to post my custom farmer's portrait. Feel free to use it so you can add your own custom portraits.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Compatible With: Vanilla, SVE, RSV, ES, and many other custom NPCs I am using in my mega-modded save. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I do plan to add the full version, which will include festivals. I just need to finish drawing up the portraits, and I'll post it soon (hopefully). [/color]

[size=4][b][u]Optional Files[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SIMPLE FOLIAGE (EARTHY)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I created a bunch of simple foliage edits for the trees in my earthy mega-modded game. I can only share the ones that I have permission to post. Why not create my own separate mod for these? I don't plan to continue this project and plan to create my own foliage mod from scratch, which will include recolors and easy permission for anyone to use. However, if anyone wants to recolor any of the trees I retextured, feel free to. [/color]


[color=#D4D4D8]AFTER DARK[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]On my quest to slowly change every NPC in my mega-modded game to Nyapu style... I decided to create my own version of "Shadow." Since there is only one portrait that needs to be replaced, I thought sharing it here would be better than creating a whole mod for it. [/color]

[size=4][b][u]Miscellaneous Files[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]PASSERBY CEMETERY - DROPPED- UNFINISHED[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I am super sad this mod was dropped. I worked hard on the portraits... oh well. I wanted to post what I did finish for anyone who wanted to use these portraits as retextured bases. Most are Nyapu bases but Popper, Roswell, and Zuuie are !00% my own art. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]LSSE - DROPPED- UNFINISHED[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I was excited by this mod. I liked the old version of Lance's portraits, so I'd started my own edited version. However, I stopped after I found out the creator removed the mod. So I decided to post these portraits for anyone interested in creating a more detailed Lance mod, or if you want to use his edits as a base. [/color]


[size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Huge thank you, Nyapu, for letting me use your artwork for my retextures. Your art inspired me to draw better pixel portraits. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you,  dugongkebalik  and acerbicon, for permission to use your Simple Foliage mod. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Big thank you to  Aedenthorn's for creating the original Farmer's Portrait mod and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/130944333]mistyspring[/url] for creating the updated version of it.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/192766184]loshionbottle[/url] for letting me retexture the character "Shadow" from your After Dark Series.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] for allowing me to retexture your mod trees.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you,  Aeywoo and Tarniyar , for creating Walk to the Desert, and allowing us modders to edit your work. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you Fellowclown for giving me permission to retexture your Passerby Characters. I am sad to see you mod removed, but I understand that you wanted to take your OCs in another direction. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for creating the amazing mod SVE and giving modders open permissions to edit your work. :D[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]TEMPORARY CREDITS[/b]
Drawberry, your seasonal cute designs are amazing! 
Everyone who worked on the East Scarp Remastered project.[/color]
